verdict.rationale: LlamaParse's own platform includes an Index product for building a hosted RAG vector search pipeline, with selectable embedding models and a managed or bring-your-own vector database, so embedding-ready ingestion exists. Parse itself is documented as returning clean markdown/JSON, and the evidence never describes chunk-level output with semantic boundaries or per-chunk metadata; Split only separates concatenated PDFs into documents, which is not RAG chunking. The embedding-model docs also sit under a deprecated path. missing for 10: documented chunking strategy or semantic-boundary segmentation, per-chunk metadata schema, chunked output exposed from Parse itself, current (non-deprecated) Index chunking docs, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, output comes pre-chunked for RAG — semantic boundaries, metadata, embedding-ready segments — not a wall of text
